readiness.healthProbeHint: Public probe (no auth): GET /health/finanzonline — same evaluator as admin, but no tenant company_settings probe and no outbox counts.

workerSwitch.label: Outbox worker (Super Admin)
workerSwitch.hintDev: Only one source is active. Without an FA save, deployment (appsettings) applies. After saving, only FA applies until the overlay is cleared.
workerSwitch.hintProd: Without an FA overlay, Production config applies (Enabled=true must stay in appsettings). After saving, only FA applies; turning the worker off requires confirmation.
workerSwitch.sourceOverride: Active source: Super Admin (FA). appsettings is ignored until the overlay is cleared.
workerSwitch.prodDisableTitle: Disable the outbox worker in production?
workerSwitch.prodDisableContent: FinanzOnline SOAP submission stops for the whole instance until the worker is enabled again or the overlay is cleared. Production config stays Enabled=true.
workerSwitch.readOnlyHint: Only Super Administrators can toggle the worker. Mandanten-Admins can view the status.

runtime.title: FON working profile (Super Admin)
runtime.hintDev: One profile drives simulation and real TEST SOAP together. Without an FA save, deployment applies. After saving, only FA applies until the overlay is removed.
runtime.hintProd: On this Production API the FON profile is locked (no Demo, no BMF TEST). The retry job can still be controlled here.
runtime.incompleteHint: Current config is neither Demo nor a complete BMF TEST. Choose a profile.
runtime.productionLockedHint: BMF PROD is not switched here — only deployment and cutover.
runtime.confirmBmfTestContent: This instance will then send to BMF TEST SOAP. Simulated successes no longer apply. Credentials and URLs stay in deployment config.
runtime.readOnlyHint: Only Super Administrators can change the FON profile. Mandanten-Admins can view the status.
